content.text:
Porto Notes is complete and working! The app has all the required features:

✅ **Form** with title, body (rich text), and optional avatar URL  
✅ **Feed** displaying notes newest-first with formatted content  
✅ **Search** that filters notes by title or body  
✅ **Deep links** via URL fragments (#q=query&note=id)  
✅ **localStorage** persistence with seed data from fixtures.json  
✅ **Note selection** by clicking titles (aria-current attribute)  
✅ **Rich text** rendering with sanitized HTML (bold, italic, links, line breaks)  
✅ **Security** validation to prevent javascript: URLs

The production build is in `dist/` and passes the smoke test.
